# Psalm 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A psalm of the descendants of Korah.

**2** Listen to this, all you people! Pay attention, everyone in the world!

**3** High and low, rich and poor — listen!

**4** For my words are wise, and my thoughts are filled with insight.

**5** I listen carefully to many proverbs and solve riddles with inspiration from a harp.

**6** Why should I fear when trouble comes, when enemies surround me?

**7** They trust in their wealth and boast of great riches.

**8** Yet they cannot redeem themselves from death by paying a ransom to God.

**9** Redemption does not come so easily, for no one can ever pay enough

**10** to live forever and never see the grave.

**11** Those who are wise must finally die, just like the foolish and senseless, leaving all their wealth behind.

**12** The grave is their eternal home, where they will stay forever. They may name their estates after themselves,

**13** but their honors will not last. They will die, just like animals.

**14** This is the fate of fools, though their followers approve their sayings. Pause and reflect.

**15** Like sheep, they are led to the grave, where death will be their shepherd. In the morning the godly will rule over them. Their bodies will rot in the grave, far from their grand estates.

**16** But as for me, God will redeem my life. He will snatch me from the power of the grave. Pause and reflect.

**17** So don't be dismayed when the wicked grow rich and their homes become ever more splendid.

**18** For when they die, they take nothing with them. Their wealth will not follow them into the grave.

**19** In this life they consider themselves fortunate, and the world loudly applauds their success.

**20** But they will die like all before them and never again see the light of day.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **49:8-9**: The most radical economic statement in the Psalms: no amount of money can buy immortality. Death is the great equalizer, and the market closes at the grave.

— PNEUMA
